title: New Orleans musicians
summary: He praises local musicians such as the Dukes of Dixieland for backing his style.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: We have about a minute left on this tape. I wonder if we can finish up on this. If there's anything else about the New Orleans musicians, or just the scene here in general, that you'd like to add?

Well, the musicians here are very capable. The local musicians playing for my style of singing, because they play that type of music. And they've got a lot of very fine, good musicians here that plays all this jazz and stuff. Like the Dukes of Dixieland and Sharky and all of them, they can play all that type of music.
